# @three-ws/portal

> Turn any website into a walkable 3D world. Reads a page's real structure and lays out a city from it: sections become buildings, links become doors, images become billboards. Pure layout in JS, a client for the three.ws Portal API, a CLI, and an MCP server.

@three-ws/portal is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/portal`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-portal/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-portal/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-portal/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-portal/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
